item.text:
Your fire resistance is **{{rd928:headlineStats[FireResist].shown}}**.

These passives could raise it; point costs include travel from your current tree:

- **Sentinel:** {{rd9213:nodes[1].stats[1]}} — {{rd9214:nodes[0].cost.passive}} points.
- **Diamond Skin:** {{rd9213:nodes[6].stats[0]}} — {{rd9214:nodes[1].cost.passive}} points.
- **Holy Fire:** {{rd9212:nodes[0].stats[1]}} — {{rd9214:nodes[3].cost.passive}} points.
- **Fire Walker:** {{rd9212:nodes[5].stats[2]}} — {{rd9214:nodes[6].cost.passive}} points.

Sentinel takes fewer points than these other options and also raises cold and lightning resistance.
